# ambientCG Metal 012

Source: https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Metal012

Asset: `Metal012`, 1K JPG maps. Downloaded 2026-07-15.

License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

These pre-generated maps are temporary source art for the Aetheria provider
bundle. They currently supply brushed aluminium plus tinted car-paint, cockpit,
steel, black-metal, and radiator materials whose original generated texture
sub-assets are no longer present. Aetheria's eventual authored texture pipeline
will bake its maps in Blender; it does not depend on Substance.
